description: Published on April 1, 2026 by The Lowell Sun BOSTON — State Rep. James Arciero was honored with a Legislator of the Year Award by the Massachusetts Municipal Association at the organization’s annual Connect 351 conference in January, recognizing his leadership and advocacy on key municipal issues
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Jim Arciero
title: State Rep. James Arciero honored for advocacy on key municipal issues at Massachusetts Municipal Association conference — State Rep. James Arciero
